subject: financial_literacy
concept: Recording transactions in a checkbook register and calculating a running balance
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student records a series of checks written and deposits made into a physical checkbook register, updating the balance each time
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a register entry to its correct effect on the running balance
exercise.abstract: Student maintains an accurate running balance across a sequence of checkbook transactions

assessment.mastery_threshold: running balance is correct after all transactions in the sequence
misconception_flags: makes a subtraction or addition error at any point that carries forward through the rest of the register

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
